title: Montserrat: Amazing Trip
text: The views were amazing. I took a lot of photos, we enjoyed the picturesque landscape. I would like to thank Sarah, our guide and Jordi, our driver. They were very lovely. I learned a lot from Sarah about the history of Montserrat. We enjoyed the train going up. I love the little present from Sara after the tour. I would highly recommend Julia travels.
author: 291aizar

title: Get ready for a LONG day,...
text: Get ready for a LONG day, but worth every minute and penny.  Montserrat is one of of the most beautiful and historic locations in Spain.  Guides are top-notch in every aspect.

title: Outstanding tours of Barcelona and Mont Serrat
text:
Two tours, two fantastic and enjoyable guides.  The trip to MontJuic was fabulous, Sara was so pleasant and knowledgeable while we walked and toured around Barcelona.

The trip to MontSerrat with Sandra was fantastic.  Sandra was amazing with the travel details and all the people with special needs.  She was fun to be with as well as very knowledgeable.  Highly recommend this destination
author: Kay_P

title: A perfect last day here
text:
I scheduled this trip after being here for a week. I regret not doing it sooner. Hugo did an amazing job telling us the history of every street we walked down, making sure to tell us where it was in relation to the Romans, and medieval times. I had no clue I was steps away from so much for so long, and I'm kicking myself for not doing it sooner. The highlight tour was 5 hours and ended at 1, exactly like he said. We didn't have to rush to get to our Montserrat tour at 2, which was very nice.

title: Barcelona yay
text: it was nice to get out and see Barcelona from a resident's perspective. Our guide was very nice and worked well with speaking several languages.

title: Great tour!
text: Great tour!  Our tour guide was amazing!  I highly recommend it.  The views are stunning.  I love that we had a two hour break in between the highlight tour and Montserrat to go grab lunch.  The day was perfect.  No complaints at all.
author: Sherel_S

title: Very nice tour of Barcelona and Monserrat and great value.
text: Going up to Monserrat and the beauty of the rock formations. We also enjoyed Mount Juic although there was a lot of walking and very hilly.
